title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 5: the flying scroll and its curse, and the woman in the ephah basket carried to the land of Shinar.

questions.text: What did the speaker see when he again lifted up his eyes?
questions.explanation: He lifted up his eyes, and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

answers.text: A man on a red horse

questions.text: What measurements did the speaker give for the flying scroll?
questions.explanation: He answered that its length is twenty cubits and its width ten cubits.

answers.text: Ten cubits long and five wide
Fifty cubits long and ten wide
Twenty cubits long and twenty wide
Twenty cubits long and ten wide

questions.text: What was he told the scroll is?
questions.explanation: He was told, "This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land."

answers.text: The curse that goes out over the whole land
The law given at the mountain
The book of the former prophets

questions.text: Which two kinds of people shall be cut off according to it?
questions.explanation: Everyone who steals shall be cut off on the one side, and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off on the other side.

answers.text: The thief and the one who swears falsely

questions.text: What will the curse do once it enters the house?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says it will remain in the middle of his house and destroy it with its timber and its stones.

answers.text: It will stand at the door of the house
It will destroy it with its timber and stones
It will carry it to the land of the north
It will fill the house with smoke

questions.text: What did the angel say was appearing when he told the speaker to lift up his eyes?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "This is the ephah basket that is appearing."

questions.text: Who was sitting in the middle of the ephah basket?
questions.explanation: A talent of lead was lifted up, and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.

answers.text: A man on a red horse

questions.text: What did he call her as he threw her down into the basket?
questions.explanation: He said, "This is Wickedness," and threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket, and threw the weight of lead on its mouth.

questions.text: What kind of wings did the two women have who lifted up the basket?
questions.explanation: There were two women with the wind in their wings, and they had wings like the wings of a stork; they lifted the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

questions.text: Where were they carrying the ephah basket?
questions.explanation: The angel said they were carrying it to build her a house in the land of Shinar, where she would be set in her own place.

answers.text: To the land of the north
